observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: ballroom with a wooden dance floor, stage in the background with band equipment and seated audience
observation.dancers: one couple, a man and a woman
observation.formation_and_space: couple dancing together while moving in a circle and traveling around the floor
observation.posture: upright posture with relatively straight knees and weight carried on the balls of the feet
observation.footwork: quick stepping and walking patterns matched to the musical beat, including chasses and turns
observation.arms_and_hands: closed ballroom hold transitioning to open hand holds and individual arm extensions
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright with natural rotational movement during turns
observation.partnering: partnered dancing in closed ballroom hold and open position with lead and follow
observation.levels_jumps_turns: standing level throughout with rotational turns and spins
observation.costume_and_props: man wears a white suit, shirt, bow tie, white shoes, and a straw hat; woman wears a light-colored dress, heels, and a matching hat
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot pressure and micro-rhythms due to low resolution and video compression

signature_moments.what: the couple enters closed ballroom frame and travels in a rapid circular progression around the floor with quick walking and stepping patterns
a dynamic spin turn where the woman twirls outward while maintaining a single-hand connection with the man
the couple separates into an open arm-in-arm line while the man tips his hat to the audience
